actions.name: Send a raw AMCP command
actions.description: The escape hatch every media server needs. Watch the two-word trap: a two-word command puts its target BETWEEN the words — 'MIXER 1-10 FILL 0 0 0.5 0.5' is right, 'MIXER FILL 1-10 ...' answers 400 ERROR.

actions.name: Send several AMCP commands as one batch
actions.description: Wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT, so every touched channel is released on the same frame — this is how a multi-screen change lands together. One line per command.

actions.name: Refresh the media library
actions.description: Re-reads media-scanner. Without media-scanner running, CasparCG has no media list of its own and every CLS/TLS/THUMBNAIL command answers 501.

feedbacks.name: CasparCG is connected to caspar-avd
feedbacks.description: A different question from 'is caspar-avd reachable'. The daemon reconnects to CasparCG with backoff, so this goes dark and recovers on its own when the server is restarted mid-rig.

feedbacks.name: OSC telemetry is arriving
feedbacks.description: Commands can work perfectly with this dark — CasparCG pushes telemetry over OSC rather than answering questions over AMCP. While it is dark, every 'is this playing' feedback below is unknowable, not false.

feedbacks.name: media-scanner is up
feedbacks.description: Not optional in CasparCG 2.5 — CLS, TLS, FLS, CINF and every THUMBNAIL command are HTTP-proxied straight to it, and answer 501 without it. The server has no media list of its own.

notes: Complete list: 18 actions (src/actions.js, one setActionDefinitions call) and 11 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js, one setFeedbackDefinitions call). Definitions are re-registered whenever the screen, cue, pad, media or template lists change (src/main.js applySnapshot/rebuild), so the dropdown choices are runtime data.

This module does not talk to CasparCG directly. It connects to the separate caspar-avd daemon (caspar-AV show control) over HTTP (REST under /api/...) and a WebSocket at /ws/ui; config fields are host (default 127.0.0.1) and port (number 1-65535, integer, default 8080) (src/main.js getConfigFields, src/api.js). The daemon speaks AMCP to CasparCG; the raw actions pass AMCP text through.
Screen, cue, clip and template dropdowns all use allowCustom: any string is sent (URL-encoded) to the daemon. Their ids are generated by caspar-avd and are free-form strings.

Options flagged useVariables are expanded by Companion before the callback runs (source comment in src/actions.js:53-56). The feedback defaultStyle values (green 0x003300/0x00ff00 for health signals, etc.) are not catalogued.

Variables and presets (src/variables.js, src/presets.js) are not catalogued. Per-screen variables are named screen_<safeId>_<name> where unsafe characters of the id become "_" (src/main.js safeId, refreshVariableValues).
Upgrade script (src/upgrades.js): a saved string port is converted to a number.
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.2.2: option values may be expressions.
